investor_assessment: FY2019 source facts and canonical settlement are usable, but Round 9 cannot support a blind method comparison or method feedback completion claim.

findings.economic_impact: A post-outcome resolver correction breaks the blind boundary and prevents attribution of the method conclusion to frozen rules.
missing_facts: A pre-outcome frozen resolver that emits a scalar implemented-action status.
prohibited_assumptions: A post-outcome bug fix may be treated as if it had been frozen before outcome access.
findings.remediation: Replay the exact pre-outcome resolver, record its non-scalar output as MODEL_ERROR, and move the scalar correction to a new method epoch.
acceptance_criteria: Round 9 resolver matches the pre-outcome commit.
Sichuan Changhong is excluded from unseen validation of the corrected epoch.

findings.economic_impact: An implementation error could pass together with an acceptance artifact generated by the same implementation.
missing_facts: An external review decision supplied independently of the artifact generator.
prohibited_assumptions: A different reviewer role string proves independent review behavior.
findings.remediation: Generate only a review candidate in code and require an external reviewer artifact before closeout.
acceptance_criteria: Closeout fails without an external review artifact.
Implementation does not construct an acceptance decision.
External NEEDS_REVISION is preserved without rewriting.

findings.economic_impact: One portfolio-scope treatment change could be counted twice and overstate evidence that the enhanced method protects against permanent loss.
missing_facts: A unique treatment-delta identity shared across explanatory dimensions.
prohibited_assumptions: Two dimensions discussing one treatment change constitute two independent method wins.
findings.remediation: Require one treatment_delta_id and one method_advantage_count for a shared treatment change in the next method epoch.
acceptance_criteria: A synthetic shared-scope event produces one treatment delta.
Several dimensions may explain the delta without increasing its count.

findings.economic_impact: Calling a FY2017-anchor band stable could make an investor overlook FY2019 year-on-year white-goods weakness and operating-cash contraction.
missing_facts: FY2019 year-on-year context next to the frozen FY2017-anchor labels.
prohibited_assumptions: A stable frozen endpoint band means the latest annual movement was stable.
findings.remediation: Keep frozen labels unchanged but identify their FY2017 anchor and show FY2019 year-on-year revenue, margin and operating-cash context separately.
acceptance_criteria: Investor readout distinguishes the two clocks.
Year-on-year context does not feed back into the frozen resolver.
